name: Your Leads Into Zoho CRM: Enriched, Deduped, Followed Up, Reported

parameters.content:
## Your Leads Into Zoho CRM: Enriched, Deduped, Followed Up, Reported

### How it works
- Your post left three blanks. Filled: UTM-tagged website forms, Apollo, Gmail then Twilio SMS.
- Every lead gets Apollo's job title, company and website, then lands in Zoho CRM with each field mapped.
- Zoho matches on email, then phone: a repeat form fill updates the lead and never restarts the follow-up.
- New leads get Email 1 within a minute and a text the next day, unless Zoho already shows them contacted.
- Room to add next: Meta instant forms, more touches, WhatsApp through the same Twilio node.

### Setup
- Add hidden utm_source and utm_campaign fields to your forms and point them at this webhook.
- Before go-live, set Authentication on the three Zoho nodes (3, 7, 11) to n8n's Zoho OAuth2 credential. The Config token is only for a first test, because a Zoho token expires in an hour.
- Add Google Ads and Website to your Zoho Lead Source picklist.
- Register your Twilio number for US business texting (A2P 10DLC) before the text goes live.
- Set this workflow's Error Workflow to your n8n alert so a failed Zoho write reaches you.

### What I need from you
- Zoho CRM admin access, your edition, and any mandatory fields on your Lead layout.
- Your Apollo API key, the Gmail inbox that sends Email 1, and your Twilio number.
- Your booking link and the wording you want in Email 1 and the text.
- Your lead volume per month and every source you run ads on.

nodes.name: Overview

parameters.content:
## 1 - CAPTURE LEADS FROM YOUR ADS AND WEBSITE FORMS

Your website and ad landing-page forms post every lead to one webhook, carrying the UTM tag your Google and Facebook ads add. That tag becomes the lead's source in Zoho. A form that drops the tag files the lead as Website, and your by-source report goes flat.

nodes.name: Section - 1 - CAPTURE LEADS FROM YOUR ADS AND WEBSITE FORMS

parameters.content:
## 2 - ENRICH EACH LEAD THROUGH APOLLO

Apollo looks the lead up by work email and adds job title, company, website and location. No match, and the lead carries on without them.

nodes.name: Section - 2 - ENRICH EACH LEAD THROUGH APOLLO

parameters.content:
## 3 - ROUTE INTO ZOHO CRM: FIELD MAPPING AND DEDUP

Every field maps to your Zoho CRM lead layout, and Zoho checks email, then phone, before it writes. New leads are created; returning ones are updated and skip the follow-up.

nodes.name: Section - 3 - ROUTE INTO ZOHO CRM: FIELD MAPPING AND DEDUP

parameters.content:
## 4 - FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE: EMAIL NOW, TEXT NEXT DAY

Email 1 goes from your Gmail within a minute, BCC'd to Zoho so it shows on the lead. The next day a text goes out, only if Zoho still shows them not contacted.

nodes.name: Section - 4 - FOLLOW-UP SEQUENCE: EMAIL NOW, TEXT NEXT DAY

parameters.content:
## 5 - REPORT: LEAD VOLUME AND CONVERSION BY SOURCE

Every Monday your Lead Dashboard tab refreshes from Zoho: leads, converted leads and conversion rate per source for the last 30 days.
